summary: Frontend-only validation of Career Blueprint AI dual-pricing funnel. Tested full Student (₹199) and Professional/IT Employee (₹499) flows end-to-end including questionnaire → result preview → locked-section pricing → comparison table highlight → MOCK Razorpay unlock → full report rendering with plan-specific sections. Both flows passed all assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: PROFESSIONAL_TYPES in data/blueprint.js includes 'Fresher' (line 17), but backend plan_for() in server.py treats Student/Fresher as student plan (₹199). The frontend's `isPro = PROFESSIONAL_TYPES.includes(p.user_type)` therefore renders the extra Professional questionnaire step for Freshers, while server returns plan='student'. The result page falls back to result.plan from server so pricing stays correct, but UX is inconsistent — a Fresher fills professional job-title/salary fields then sees a Student-priced report. Either remove 'Fresher' from PROFESSIONAL_TYPES or align backend to charge professional for Freshers.
ResultPreview.jsx is ~385 lines and mixes preview + locked + full report. Consider splitting FullReport and LockedSection into their own files for maintainability.
PaymentModal mock flow does not validate that order.amount matches the plan price client-side; relies entirely on server. Acceptable for MOCK mode but consider an assertion before pay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Student and IT Employee end-to-end funnels validated via Playwright on external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: success-score render, locked-section plan name + ₹199/₹999 vs ₹499/₹2499 strikethrough, both unlock CTAs include ₹{price}, comparison-table column highlight switches on plan, MOCK payment via /api/create-order (mode=mock) + /api/verify-payment unlocks full-report, download-pdf-btn present, 4 upsell cards rendered. PRO-only sections (Your Potential Scores, Resume/LinkedIn & Interview Strategy, IT Employee Future Report, Career Switch Opportunities) correctly appear ONLY in the Professional report and are absent in the Student report. Note inconsistency: 'Fresher' is in PROFESSIONAL_TYPES (shows pro questionnaire step) but backend bills as student — see code review comment.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in tested flows.
